name: modster-hunter
description: Catch Modsters while you wait for Claude.

includeBuiltins.title: Include built-in content
includeBuiltins.description: Load the biomes and Modsters that ship with the mod

encounterIdleTimeoutSec.title: Encounter idle timeout (seconds)
encounterIdleTimeoutSec.description: Seconds without a throw before a Modster wanders off

showIdleLine.title: Show idle line
showIdleLine.description: Show the current biome in the band between encounters

showInBand.title: Show in the band
showInBand.description: Draw the game above the prompt. Off: one row during encounters only. Changing it ends an encounter in progress

encounterPane.title: Encounter pane
encounterPane.description: off, when-opened (reopens after /modsters hunt) or always (every session). Changing it ends an encounter in progress

showInSpinner.title: Show in the spinner
showInSpinner.description: Name the Modster in the spinner line while Claude works

showInStatusLine.title: Show in the status line
showInStatusLine.description: Show the encounter in the status line while one is up
